PH020.review_text: "I purchased it on 3rd May 2026 when I saw that it had a 10-day return policy from the seller Gold-Enterprise. After receiving the phone, I noticed that it started overheating. It idles at 35–36 degrees and goes above 40 degrees with minimal YouTube usage. When I contacted Amazon support for a return on the 8th day, they denied any return policy even after I shared screenshots showing the 10-day return policy at the time of purchase. One of the supervisors was extremely rude and disconnected the call. If you see a return policy mentioned for an electronics product, don't assume it will be honored. Never buying from Amazon again."

PH007.review_text: "I have always been from Xiaomi, a nest of bugs and errors everywhere, updates every month that fix one thing and break another. What made me look for another brand was the terrible proximity sensor. I switched to Realme and it's another world. The best of Xiaomi but without those errors. The cell phone works very smoothly, the camera is the strong point, everything works as it should. Fast charging, good fluidity, great camera, the cell phone is beautiful, and the proximity sensor works. Android 14 with 2 major updates guaranteed. If they continue like this, I can't get out of Realme."

So great for me."

PH009.review_text: "bought the Moto G37 Power 5G mainly for its massive battery, and while the battery life is excellent, the overall experience has been disappointing. The HD+ display lacks sharpness and vibrant colors, making videos and browsing less enjoyable. Performance feels average, with occasional lag during multitasking and app switching. The camera is decent in daylight but struggles in low-light conditions. Charging speed is also slower than expected considering the large 7000mAh battery. Overall, apart from the battery backup, the phone does not offer the value and user experience I was expecting in this price range."
"I bought this phone for my mother, and she started having this strange problem. When she is on a call, after 2-3 minutes of continuous call, the receiver starts to hear a distorted/unclear voice."

PH057.review_text: "I have been using the Oppo A6 Pro 5G for a while now, and it’s been a reliable companion for daily use. The battery life is honestly the standout—it easily lasts more than a day without any stress. Performance is smooth for regular tasks like calls, browsing, and social media, and the display feels nice and fluid. The camera does a decent job in good lighting, though it’s not the best in low light. Overall, it’s a practical and dependable phone, especially if long battery life is your priority."

reviews.review_text: "Before you fall for the tempting specs of the new Edge 70 Fusion—like its massive 7000 mAh battery, 1.5K quad-curved display, or premium design—please read this warning. I am writing this because I bought its predecessor, the Moto Edge 50 Fusion, on Amazon in January 2025. It looked like a premium champion on day one, but it hid a critical hardware vulnerability that turned it into a completely useless paperweight right after the warranty ended. My Experience with Motorola Quality: The Sudden Glitch: In May 2026 (just 16 months of very careful use), my phone's screen completely went white. No touch response, no recovery—it completely bricked out of nowhere. The 'Moto Care' Shrug: I took it to an official authorized service center. They didn't even run a deep diagnostic. They took one look at the white screen and immediately declared it a motherboard failure. Zero Accountability: Their exact response was: 'If this happened within 1 year, we would replace it. But since your warranty is over, nothing can be done.' No solutions, no component discounts. A total loss of ₹20K+ in under 1.5 years. Why You Should Hesitate Before Buying the Edge 70 Fusion: Unresolved Hardware Cycles: Online tech forums and community threads are packed with users facing this exact same screen flickering, white screen, and sudden motherboard loop. It points to a serious long-term component optimization issue in Moto's mid-range lineup. Exorbitant Repair Costs: If your Edge 70 Fusion suffers a motherboard breakdown out of warranty, the official repair will cost you nearly as much as the phone itself. No Support Past Day 365: Moto Care will completely abandon you the exact day your 12-month standard warranty expires, leaving you to bear a 100% financial loss. Final Verdict: A phone is an investment that should easily last 2 to 3 years. Motorola has completely lost my trust. Don't risk your hard-earned money on flashy designs; look at brands with proven long-term durability and cooperative post-warranty customer support."

"Considering the Price and the specs that this brand offered is what many brand lacks now a days solely for cost-cuttings, and fit themselves in a specific price bracket with definitely low features than this one. Punch-Hole Amoled Display, Indisplay fingerprint sensor, Android 15 out of box with Android 16 Assured and 2 years of security patch software updates, 50 MP rear camera which gives good quality photos, 8 MP front average quality photos, the processor is great for normal everyday tasks without any lags or gitters, battery and the 33w fast charging is great at this price. Overall a great device to consider under this budget of 11500-12500 price bracket. I'm a Galaxy S24 Ultra user, for me the software and camera are the top priorities, I found this phone perfectly fitting in bridging the gap between low range and mid range phones. Few things I didn't liked in terms of software more refinement is needed to organize it more categorically. For other things, basic software level fine tuning with future updates would definitely turn this phone as a budget best. Got to know this a rebranded version of previously launched phone Lava Blaze Amoled 2. Don't know why they have to rebrand it again as Lava Bold 2. Rest, currently I'm testing the phone very minutely in day-to-day real world scenarios. I'll further tune this review accordingly and add HQ Pictures after a week or so."

"Battery: After one month of usage, I can give you genuine review about the battery. It will help you in decision making. I unplugged the charger at exactly 8 AM. After that I used all Apps for entertainment, office work app like google meet, excel, camera(atleast 500 times), oken scanner, whatsapp calls, msg, video calls, insta, x. Exactly - the mobile shutdown at 0% after 16 hours 40 minutes. The last 3% stood 37 minutes when I was watching YouTube. The last one minute still stood 16 minutes. 100% Charging it takes about about 1 hour. In 8 minutes, the battery charges 0 to 12%. Camera : Great, Dual Video Capture. Speaker: Mind blowing. Dolby Atmos. Display: Superb Grip: Fear of loosing if not used too of slim phone. Mobile very thin. Durability: Always use ring 💍 holder on back cover and a military grade back cover. Software: A MAJOR GLITCH- WHEN YOU SCROLL TWITTER VIDEOS IN CHROME, THEN PREVIOUS VIDEO SOUND KEEP COMING IN YOUR CURRENT VIDEO UNTIL OR UNLESS YOU GO BACK AND PAUSE THAT VIDEO AND THEN COME BACK TO PLAY YOUR CURRENT VIDEO. I THINK MOTOROLA NEEDS TO FIX THIS. Overall 3.8/5 just because of Camera, Battery, and Sound."

"For the price- it is a very good phone. Clean software, nice display, sufficient features. Although camera is average, but in my case it was never a priority. Battery life is decent but it's been only a day so will test it more. Processor is good enough for daily tasks not gaming or high intensity activity. Design is nice. Headphone jack (3.5mm) is missing, it should have been given. As for software update (1 year). Security update (2 years) could have been more than 1 and 2 years. I would recommend this phone for daily use and heavy tasks. The amazon service has gotten worse in the few past years. I ordered this phone on 14 may it showed delivery on 20 may, but when I completed the payment the delivery date changed to 26 may. Phone was dispatched on 21 may evening. Although I got it on 25 a day before the changed delivery date. The delivery experience was not good at all, had me worried if I was going to get the phone itself or not. Everybody knows how many types of scams are going on in our country."

"Our relatives and we have been using Lava smartphones for last 4-5 years. Lava phones' quality and durability is very good. They do not become sluggish or lose battery capacity. The only issues I see is that they are slow in providing security updates. And they have extremely few service centers as they provide home service, which is a bit costly. About this phone Lava Bold 2 5 G .. This is a relaunched version of Lava Amoled 2. The phone's AMOLED display, stereo speakers, and overall fit and finish is very good. It takes around 90 minutes to charge from 0 to 100 % i.e., around one minute for every one percent of charge using the Lava charger that comes with the phone. The camera is decent, tuned for low-light photos and provides true colors. The phone comes with Android 15 with 1 year OS and 2 years security upgrades. Lava should add a battery protection feature to avoid the battery getting overcharged. The phone has background streaming feature and call recording. Overall, I highly recommend this phone. Good job by Lava..."

"The worst phone I bought ever. To be honest, I wouldn't even give it a single star if that were an option, but since one star is the minimum required to post a review, I am forced to give it that. The constant glitches and app refreshing are so frustrating that even basic multitasking is impossible. There is absolutely no point in buying this device. It is a complete waste of money and I highly recommend staying away from it. Don't make the same mistake I did!"
